terra.problem: Saying the land was already handed over goes beyond God saying He has given it to the Israelites.
The text does not say nobody will meet Moses on the mountain. It also does not establish that looking is his whole assignment.
Saying Moses' part ends when he sees the land overlooks his instructions to commission Joshua.
The claims about Korah being from earlier in Numbers and not being Moses' brother have no supporting references.
The passage records Moses' request but does not say the people were his first thought.
The statement that Moses knows sheep without a shepherd wander adds an unmarked thought. Matthew 9:36 describes the crowds as like sheep without a shepherd; it does not say Jesus used that picture.
The claim that Israel had fighting ahead is a Bible fact without a supporting reference.
The claim that Joshua is going to lead an army needs a supporting Bible reference.
Saying Moses uses his hands and that's all overlooks the other instructions, including commissioning Joshua.
The quotation is followed by a sentence break before 'with Eleazar,' leaving a sentence fragment and a reference on its own.
The text gives obedience as the reason for conferring authority; it does not say the authority is how the people will know to follow Joshua.
Saying Joshua won't be guessing his way through goes beyond the instruction for Eleazar to seek counsel.
The text says Moses obeyed, but does not say he acted without stalling or got right to it.
The text says Moses obeyed, but does not establish that he did so without arguing or dragging his feet.
